 Tank Dell expected to see increase in snaps 
 by Ari Koslow | Texans Correspondent | Wed, Nov 4th 2026, 4:46pm EST 
 Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said WR Tank Dell ’s snap will go up. ( DJ Bien-Aime on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Ryans clarified that it isn't because Jaylin Noel is out but because the natural progression of Dell working his way back. He remains a risky start for fantasy managers.
